For a sophisticated vegetarian dinner, Todd English's Tuscany in the Casino of the Sky is my top recommendation. The wood-fired aroma hits you the moment you walk in, and their handmade pastas and specialty pizzas are crafted with a level of detail that makes them a favorite for guests seeking meat-free options.

They are open tonight until 10:00 PM with a business casual dress code and a price range of approximately $$$$. Given that it is a Friday evening, I would suggest a reservation to secure a table near the open kitchen where you can watch the chefs at work. If you are in the mood for something more casual but still Italian-inspired, Mohegan Sun Caputo Trattoria also serves excellent brick-oven pizzas and pasta dishes until 10:00 PM.

After dinner, the Wolf Den in the Casino of the Earth usually has great live music if you want to keep the evening going. I can connect you with our host team to finalize a booking for Tuscany if that sounds like the right atmosphere for tonight?
